content.title: Visit - Hofstra University
content.text: DISCOVER WHERE YOU BELONG Campus Tours and Info Sessions Student-Led Campus Tours Walk the campus with a Pride Guide and get a real student perspective. Information Sessions Learn about admission, financial aid, and academics from our team. Hop on the Hofstra Trolley! Our new family-friendly trolley adds a fun, accessible way to explore campus! What to Expect: 90-minute tours include indoor and outdoor stops. Visit classrooms, residence halls, dining areas, and vibrant student life spaces. No limits to family, friends, or guests! Meet with current students and an admission counselor. Mobility and accessibility accommodations are available upon request Special Events We host a variety of on-campus events throughout the year for prospective and admitted students, including the following: Open house events Academic preview days Admitted student celebrations See what’s coming up: View Upcoming Events Getting Here By Plane We’re 30–45 minutes from JFK and LaGuardia airports. By Train Take the LIRR to Hempstead or Mineola. A free Hofstra shuttle is available from the Hempstead station. Staying Overnight Accessibility and Special Requests We’re committed to making your visit inclusive and accessible. Most tour routes are accessible, and we are happy to arrange additional accommodations, such as ASL interpretation, upon request during registration. More Ways to Experience Hofstra While you’re here, explore everything our campus has to offer: Catch a Performance! Music, drama, and dance students perform year-round. Visit Hofstra Athletics! We compete in NCAA Division I and have a vibrant club and intramural teams. See What’s Happening Need to Cancel or Reschedule? Plans change! We understand. Reply to your confirmation email or call 516-463-6700 and we’ll help you rebook. WHERE YOUR JOURNEY TAKES SHAPE Schedule your visit today and feel the energy of our dynamic campus, where academic exploration meets real-world opportunity.
